---
title: "Datetime features"
---

Steps that split date and datetime columns into model-ready numeric and
categorical features (the grouping follows
[Feature Engineering A–Z](https://feaz-book.com/)). They run early in the
[eight-position ordering](../basics/four-stages-eight-steps.qmd), so the
levels they create flow into
[Numeric: dummy variables](../four-stages/numeric-dummy-variables.qmd).

No shoez step fills this family yet; three planned steps
([#61](https://github.com/tidymodels/shoez/issues/61),
[#217](https://github.com/tidymodels/shoez/issues/217)):

- Date features — year, month, day of week, and friends from a date column.
- Datetime features — the same plus hour, minute, and second resolution.
- Holiday indicators — indicator columns for holidays near each date.

*Stub — content to come.*
